entries.085a3a93982a3d03: As a mid-sized logistics company, it sets out a basic policy aiming to provide services that respond to customer needs while making use of its own characteristics, and to become a company where employees can work safely and energetically. As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it cites: strengthening its regionally based strategy; proposing and implementing integrated logistics systems, such as distribution center operations; promoting combined and joint logistics; promoting procurement logistics, temperature-controlled logistics and industrial waste recycling businesses; expanding specialized technical services such as house moving and installation of machinery and fixtures; expanding into wider areas through alliances and developing new services; and promoting safety and environmental conservation activities.

entries.2f3570f3047ce3ae: Taiho Transportation is a logistics company headquartered in Naka-ku, Nagoya. Established in 1951 as Chuo Kyuhai, it does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and its number of employees is 681 (as of March 20, 2026).
entries.4eeefbe6aede3866: A business that holds certification for automobile disassembly and maintenance business under the Road Transport Vehicle Act and operates one maintenance plant in Aichi Prefecture (designated as a private vehicle inspection facility), providing vehicle inspection, periodic inspection and general repair of automobiles. In addition, it runs an insurance agency business, and carries out solar power generation business at the Miyoshi Branch.
entries.510dd0bacebf27a3: Its main customers are shippers of consumer-related cargo, such as food products and daily necessities and general goods. It operates in Aichi, Gifu, Mie and Shizuoka as its operating area, transporting cargo, and provides integrated logistics services in combination with its warehousing business.
entries.5f1fd3b6a33cf630: Shippers of consumer-related cargo are its main customers
entries.63446b66c17ea835: A business that holds a general motor truck transportation business permit under the Motor Truck Transportation Business Act and transports mainly consumer-related cargo such as foodstuffs and daily necessities in its operating areas of Aichi, Gifu, Mie and Shizuoka Prefectures. It also holds permits for first-class and second-class freight forwarding business under the Freight Forwarding Business Act. It has 9 branches in Aichi Prefecture and 1 branch in Mie Prefecture, and provides transportation services as part of comprehensive logistics services together with its warehouse business.
entries.695dfc30b728e1c0: It describes as its own strength a system that links its freight transportation and warehousing businesses to provide integrated logistics services covering collection, storage, distribution processing, delivery and recovery.
entries.6a3ee3b87765e89c: A business that holds certification for automobile disassembly and maintenance business under the Road Transport Vehicle Act and operates one maintenance plant in Aichi Prefecture (designated as a private vehicle inspection facility), providing vehicle inspection, periodic inspection and general repair of automobiles.

entries.e144c91c196f9e47: A business that holds a warehouse business license under the Warehouse Business Act and operates eight logistics centers in Aichi Prefecture and one in Mie Prefecture. Through coordination with the freight transportation business, it provides integrated comprehensive logistics services from collection, storage and distribution processing to delivery and collection.
entries.e67fb27f774e6c9c: This business model combines a freight transportation business that carries consumer-related cargo and a warehousing business that provides storage and distribution processing, within an operating area covering Aichi, Gifu, Mie and Shizuoka, and earns revenue through an integrated logistics service from collection to delivery.

entries.f7e50289d93ac76c: It operates three businesses: freight transportation, warehousing and other. In the freight transportation business, it has bases comprising 9 branches in Aichi Prefecture and 1 branch in Mie Prefecture, and in the warehousing business it has 8 distribution centers in Aichi Prefecture and 1 in Mie Prefecture. In its other business, it provides vehicle inspection and maintenance, non-life insurance agency services and solar power generation.
